visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair wearing a white t-shirt stands outside a brightly lit retail storefront with a red 'COSMED' sign. He smiles and gestures enthusiastically with his hands while looking directly into the camera. The background shows a busy city street with bicycles parked and posters on the glass doors. (2) The man walks into the store, passing rows of shelves filled with various colorful beauty and skincare products. He stops in front of a display rack with a video screen playing an advertisement. He points at a product on the shelf and picks up a small, round, beige compact case. (3) A close-up shot shows the man holding the beige compact and opening it to reveal a white powder puff. He looks into a small handheld mirror and begins dabbing the powder puff onto his cheek and forehead, demonstrating the product's application. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his smooth skin. (4) The man points to another display of small, rectangular makeup palettes. He picks up a light pink palette and applies a swatch of the shimmering powder onto the back of his hand with his finger, showing the texture and color. He then uses a makeup brush to apply the powder to his upper cheekbone. (5) In a close-up, the man holds several thin eyeliner pencils of different shades. He chooses a light brown pencil and draws a line and a wavy stroke on his inner forearm to demonstrate the pigment and ease of use. He holds the pencil up to the camera with a satisfied expression. (6) The man moves to a different section of the store with red branding. He picks up a small bottle of eyebrow gel and applies it to his eyebrow with a small brush, carefully shaping the hairs. He looks into a mirror while doing this, showing the before and after effect on his brow. (7) He moves to a display of mascara with purple and gold packaging. He pulls out the mascara wand to show the brush head and then carefully applies it to his eyelashes, looking upwards. A split-screen comparison appears, showing a close-up of his eye with and without the mascara. (8) The man stands in the middle of a store aisle holding a black shopping basket filled with the five products he previously demonstrated. He smiles broadly, holds the products up for the camera to see, and gives a thumbs-up gesture, concluding his recommendations.

The narration maintains a fast tempo, emphasizing words with varied pitch. The BGM continues smoothly, but a subtle 'pop' effect is heard when product labels appear on screen. (3) The acoustic texture remains bright. The speaker's voice is front-and-center, exhibiting high arousal and enthusiasm. A 'click' sound effect accompanies the demonstration of the powder puff, layered over the continuous musical track. (4) Transitioning to the second product, a soft 'swipe' sound effect is heard. The speaker's pitch rises as he describes the shimmering effect of the palette. The BGM remains consistent in tempo and energy. (5) A series of quick 'digital UI' chirps occur as the speaker swatches the eyeliner. The vocal intensity remains high, with clear articulation and minimal pausing, creating a sense of urgency and excitement. (6) A sharp 'whoosh' marks the move to the Integrate brand. The speaker's tone becomes slightly more instructional as he describes the eyebrow gel application, but the high energy and upbeat BGM persist throughout. (7) A percussive 'hit' sound effect introduces the mascara segment. The speaker uses more rising intonations, sounding surprised by the results. The music and voice are well-balanced, with no technical noise interference. (8) The final phase features a celebratory tone in the voice. A final 'ding' and a crescendo in the BGM conclude the video as the speaker encourages viewers to buy the products. The overall audio design is dense and polished.
